issue_context.title: Clarify apt_repository filename default
issue_context.body:
### Summary

The [`filename` parameter docs](https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/latest/collections/ansible/builtin/apt_repository_module.html#parameter-filename) don't give enough info to tell how the file name is generated.

I believe my `repo: deb https://packagecloud.io/linz/prod/ubuntu/ {{ ansible_distribution_release }} main` is hanging indefinitely ~~, and I suspect this has something to do with the file name being a duplicate, resulting in a background prompt which is never printed or dismissed, but it's hard to tell based on the [code](https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/f3be331c9cb2f2c6edeb0bdf28a1e8a9681d727c/lib/ansible/modules/apt_repository.py#L235-L258)~~ (Based on copying the code into a Python interpreter it looks like the generated file name is `packagecloud_io_linz_prod_ubuntu.list`, which looks fine.).

### Issue Type

Documentation Report

### Component Name

lib/ansible/modules/apt_repository.py


<!--- boilerplate: components_banner --->

The automatic filename effectively follows these rules:

1. Based off of the URL (`https://user:pass@packagecloud.io/linz/prod/ubuntu/`)
2. The URL Scheme is removed (`user:pass@packagecloud.io/linz/prod/ubuntu/`)
3. username and password in the URL is removed (`packagecloud.io/linz/prod/ubuntu/`)
4. All contiguous non-alphanumeric(english) characters are removed and replaced with a single underscore (`packagecloud_io_linz_prod_ubuntu`)
5. `.list` appended (`packagecloud_io_linz_prod_ubuntu.list`)

Documentation fix:

Add the additional information from https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/79306#issuecomment-1307897044 to  https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blame/devel/lib/ansible/modules/apt_repository.py#L75

NOTE -  this is a python file so follow the format already present and do not have extended lines beyond 80 characters or it will trigger CI failures.
I'd like to work on this issue! Please let me know if this is possible!
